changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_permission (grouping, code, entity_name, action_name, can_maker_checker) SELECT v.grouping, v.code, 'VIRTUALACCOUNT', v.action_name, v.can_maker_checker FROM (VALUES ('portfolio', 'CREATE_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'CREATE', false), ('portfolio', 'READ_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'READ', false), ('portfolio', 'UPDATE_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'UPDATE', false), ('portfolio', 'CLOSE_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'CLOSE', true), ('portfolio', 'CHANGEPARENT_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'CHANGEPARENT', true) ) AS v (grouping, code, action_name, can_maker_checker) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_permission p WHERE p.code = v.code);

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_role WHERE name = 'Banking API'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r, m_permission p WHERE r.name = 'Banking API' AND p.code IN ('CREATE_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'READ_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'UPDATE_VIRTUALACCOUNT', 'CLOSE_VIRTUALACCOUNT') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);
